statement.text: A latin square is even if the product of the signs of all of the row and column permutations is 1 and is odd otherwise. Conjecture For every positive even integer $n$, the number of even latin squares of order $n$ and the number of odd latin squares of order $n$ are different.

title: Even vs. odd latin squares
